title: All courses, teacher or TBA
statementMd:
List every course with its teacher's name, or `TBA` if none.

Expected columns: `title`, `teacher`.

Tables: `teachers`, `courses`, `students`, `enrollments`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT c.title, COALESCE(t.name, 'TBA') AS teacher FROM courses c LEFT JOIN teachers t ON t.id = c.teacher_id;
```
